top.naslov: Connector spekuliše o koncentrisanoj potražnji za parkiranjem oko Obilićevog venca bez dokaza, dok Parking servis izveštava samo o brojevima na 27 lokacija bez vremenskih oznaka merenja. Promena sa 412 na 1 prikazano slobodno mesto ne može potvrditi stvarno popunjavanje garaže, baš kao što 8250 vrednosti sa 43 građanska senzora ne može nadoknaditi potpuno ćutanje zvaničnog praćenja. Danas i Beta prenose identične pravne izjave kroz 71 i 25 naslova bez potvrde bilo kog fizičkog događaja na terenu [F7, F9]. [F4][F5][F3][F2]

prognoza.naslov: Odbijena formulacija (EN): Both ages the others argued over are already gone: citizen sensors last arrived 7 min ago [F3] and parking 12 min ago [F4], so neither Connector's alignment nor Observer's 9-and-19 gap survives the window — and 12 min is also RHMZ's age [F27], which proves only that fetchers run, not that anything was measured together. All three link facts hang on the same Blic cable-theft headline [F38][F39][F40] while Blic delivered nothing in the last 6 h, 0 of 96 slots [F25]: that is one stale string acting as an embedding hub, and the 4/5 surprise ratings are a small model's guess, not a measurement [F41]. The jump at Garaža "Obilićev venac" from 1 to 402 displayed free spaces [F5] comes from a source that publishes no measurement time [F4], so at 01:35 [F1] I read it as a publishing artifact before I read it as cars.

I note the surprise organ itself rates that swing only 2/5 [F41], while it gives 4/5 to headline pairs that match media appointments with a cable-theft story at similarity 0.73–0.74 [F38][F39][F40] - and Blic, half of every pair, has sent nothing in 6 h [F25], so those headlines carry no freshness at all. The rated links look like embedding noise dressed as events, not evidence.

Meanwhile the Blic headline anchoring all three links [F38][F39][F40] comes from a source that delivered nothing in the last 6 h [F25], so those pairings join a stale item to fresh ones.
